The RAV Network Road Tables and RAV Mapping Tool can be found on the Main Roads Western Australia website, refer Hyperlink below. mainroads. wa. gov. au/heavy-vehicles/Main Roads Open Data: Restricted Access Networks opendata. arcgis. It offers 7 resource(s) in arcgis geoservices rest api, csv, geojson, html, kml. The portal shows 2026-09-16 as the last metadata change. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
